extracted.intended_audience: comics fans, students, scholars, and researchers interested in The Comics Journal archives
extracted.subtask_description: Information and requirements for purchasing and activating a subscription to The Comics Journal (TCJ) Digital Archives, including what content is included, billing behavior, and steps needed to enable access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content scope of the TCJ Digital Archives
rubrics_metrics.description: Facsimile scans of the print magazine from its origin as a 1970s fanzine until the current issue, including career-spanning interviews, reviews and analysis, sketchbooks, industry news, and historical coverage of comics (e.g., 1800s newspaper strips, Mad magazine, EC cartoonists), and documentation of alternative, mini-, and web-comics scenes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists example creators (Charles M. Schulz, Alison Bechdel, Chris Ware, Jack Kirby, Moto Hagio, Frank Miller, Alan Moore, Lynda Barry, Brian Michael Bendis) and emphasizes usefulness for fans, students, and scholars as a research/reading resource.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription billing and renewal policy
rubrics_metrics.description: A subscription is an ongoing package that will charge you once per year for access to the digital archives until you cancel, pause, or skip your next charge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Canceling, skipping, or pausing your next charge results in losing access to the archives until you restart the subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription activation process and required user actions
rubrics_metrics.description: After purchasing, you receive an order confirmation email containing a link to a Google Form; you must enter your name and email in that form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You should whitelist helpme@fantagraphics.com to ensure you receive the confirmation email. Your TCJ archive subscription will not be active until you have submitted the Google Form and received an email from customer service confirming that access is active.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform/format of delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Access is provided to digital facsimile scans of the print magazine (digital archive format).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists 'Format' under specs (implying digital access), but no additional technical delivery details are provided on this page.
